{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
# This ensures paired observations for correlation
data_clean = data.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = data_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(data_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print result
print(f'Pearson correlation: {correlation}')"}
